title: fix(types,cli): 20 of the ADR-0080 public blocks validate, and the ratchet counts the namespaced half (objectui#10872, batch 1)
body:
Part of #10872
Clause-②: yes

Batch 1 of the namespaced slice of the objectui#10859 family. **20 of the 28 namespaced ADR-0080 public blocks** now validate — every one whose props `@objectstack/spec` declares as a `ComponentPropsMap` row, less `element:number`. The other 8 are held on measured readings, and the seat's ruling on objectui#10872 keeps them held (Acceptance notes). Measured split posted on the card before this PR: comment 5862647089. Head `0212421eda`: fix round 1 (`42f1cd1d2c`) fixed the two CI shards red at `4679a3120` (block-config node oracle, handler-key alias census) and swept the repo for suites that introspect the arm list; fix round 2 (`0212421eda`) is text only — the contract review's wording corrections to the changeset, the module docblock and one checker comment.

## What changed

- **`packages/types/src/zod/public-blocks.zod.ts` (new).** One arm per armed block — `PageHeaderBlockSchema`, `PageTabsBlockSchema`, `PageCardBlockSchema`, `PageAccordionBlockSchema`, `PageSectionBlockSchema`, `PageFooterBlockSchema`, `PageSidebarBlockSchema`, `RecordDetailsBlockSchema`, `RecordHighlightsBlockSchema`, `RecordRelatedListBlockSchema`, `RecordPathBlockSchema`, `RecordActivityBlockSchema`, `RecordDiscussionBlockSchema`, `RecordHistoryBlockSchema`, `RecordQuickActionsBlockSchema`, `RecordReferenceRailBlockSchema`, `RecordAlertBlockSchema`, `ElementTextBlockSchema`, `ElementButtonBlockSchema`, `ElementDividerBlockSchema` — and the category union `PublicBlockComponentSchema`.
- **`packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts`.** The 21 names on the `./zod` barrel; `PublicBlockComponentSchema` joins `AnyComponentSchema`'s arm list.
- **`packages/types/src/zod/README.md`.** An "ADR-0080 Public Blocks (20)" group.
- **Pins:** `packages/types/src/__tests__/public-block-arms-10872.test.ts` (new), and the objectui#10859 ratchet file `packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts` extended with the namespaced count and an in-process `objectui validate` run.
- **Ledgers:** 21 `EXCLUSIONS` rows in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`; the 17 `ComponentPropsMap` row symbols the arms read added to `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts`'s `IMPORTED` differential.
- **Fix round 1 (`42f1cd1d2c`):** `block-config-schema-parity-8216.test.ts` (app-shell previews) — the NODE oracle judges an arm whose props live in a `properties` object member AT that member, derived from the arm (`propsLevelOf`), plus a control row; `check-handler-key-read-sites.test.ts` — `page:tabs` leaves the objectui#9573 alias population and its `onTabChange` read is pinned as judged on its own arm; `check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs` — two prose paragraphs that named `page:tabs` as an alias, amended.
- **Fix round 2 (`0212421eda`, text only):** the changeset's lead sentence names twenty blocks; its flat-props bullet separates keys `BaseSchema` does not declare from the ones it does; the `action:*` reason in the changeset and in `public-blocks.zod.ts`'s docblock is the seat's (no spec row yet, measured upstream on objectstack-ai/objectstack#20371), and the docblock's flat-key paragraph carries the same `BaseSchema` distinction; `check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs`'s amendment points at boundary 3.
- **Changesets:** `.changeset/10872-public-block-zod-arms.md` (`'@object-ui/types': minor`, the `Clause-②: yes` line, no BREAKING banner); one dated note on `.changeset/8344-node-recursion-point-redirect.md` (objectui#10533 form, frontmatter byte-identical) — see Acceptance notes.

## M1 — reproduced on `main` (`c6678b1bd`)

- `safeValidateSchema({ type: KEY })` over the 419 namespaced keys of `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES`: **418 refused** with `invalid_union` at `type`; `ui:calendar` accepted. Bare: 76 (the objectui#10859 pin).
- `objectui validate` (the CLI's `validate`, in-process on source) on a page whose children are `page:header` (`properties.title`), `action:button` (`label`, `actionType: "url"`, `target`) and `record:details`: exit 1, `Schema validation failed`, one refusal per block — `No arm accepts type "page:header" at children → 0.`, `… "action:button" at children → 1.`, `… "record:details" at children → 2.`
- At head the same page fails at `action:button` alone; the page of `page:header` + `record:details` + `element:text` — batch 1's page pin as the seat's ruling amends it — prints `✓ Schema is valid!`, `Type: page`, exit 0.

### The α / β split (419 namespaced keys)

Twin = text after the first colon. "Same registration" = the namespaced key and its bare twin come out of the same registration call (read from `deriveRegistryKeys`, the derivation `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES` is generated from).

| class | keys | refused at `type` |
|---|---|---|
| (α) same registration, bare twin validates | 149 | 149 |
| (α′) same registration, bare twin itself refused — objectui#10859's bare half | 77 | 77 |
| (β) bare spelling belongs to a DIFFERENT registration | 44 | 43 (`ui:calendar` accepted) |
| (β) no bare spelling | 149 | 149 |

By spelling alone α would read 189; 40 of those are false twins, the triage's own example among them (`view:grid` is plugin-grid's registration, bare `grid` the layout primitive). All 28 public blocks are β (15 with no bare spelling, 13 whose bare spelling is another component).

## M2 — the 28 public blocks, by declaration source

| source | count | blocks |
|---|---|---|
| spec `ComponentPropsMap` row (installed 17.4.0) | 21 | `page:header` `page:tabs` `page:card` `page:accordion` `page:section` `page:footer` `page:sidebar` · `record:details` `record:highlights` `record:related_list` `record:path` `record:activity` `record:discussion` `record:history` `record:quick_actions` `record:reference_rail` `record:alert` · `element:text` `element:number` `element:button` `element:divider` |
| no spec row; registration `inputs` only | 3 | `record:line_items` `element:definition-list` `element:repeater` |
| no spec row; TS schema types in `@object-ui/components` + registration `inputs` | 4 | `action:button` `action:group` `action:menu` `action:icon` |
| no declaration anywhere | 0 | — |
| bare-key twin arm | 0 | — |

Disagreements, spec wins: `element:definition-list` / `element:repeater` are in the spec's reserved `element:` namespace but not its vocabulary (`isKnownComponentType` false, `hasReservedComponentNamespace` true), so the spec refuses the TYPE at author time; `record:line_items` is in the spec's `STRING_ARM_REGISTERED_TYPES` ledger as a row still to be measured.

## M3 — homes, Serial

New module `public-blocks.zod.ts` (no open PR can hold it) plus `index.zod.ts`. ⛔ Not `blocks.zod.ts`: it is the objectui#4895 tombstone, pinned empty by `block-family-retired-4895.test.ts`. Re-read at fix round 2. `origin/main` is `45dbf1cbae`: since `b2683a2c0e` it has landed objectui#10714, #10780 and #10852. None of them touches a file of this diff, a `type` literal, `BaseSchema` (`base.zod.ts` / `base.ts`), `known-schema-types.ts` or `public-blocks.ts` — #10714's zod edits are the list-item and tabs-item `body` refusals in `data-display.zod.ts` / `layout.zod.ts`. `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this branch (`0212421eda`) against `45dbf1cbae` is clean (exit 0), so main was not merged in. CI on `42f1cd1d2c` ran on a merge ref over `b2683a2c0e` — every workflow run for that head reports PR base `b2683a2c0e`, all 26 completed `success` or `skipped`. Open PRs on these surfaces: objectui#10890 edits `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` in a different hunk (merge-tree of the two heads, `0212421eda` against `f6891cde45`, exit 0); objectui#10889 edits other `packages/types` files and none of this diff's; objectui#10892 (a citation sweep, 106 files) edits `.changeset/8344-node-recursion-point-redirect.md`, which this diff also touches, in a different hunk (merge-tree against `afed8aa6b4`, exit 0). The other open PRs (objectui#10891, #10886, #10884, #10777, #10278) touch no file of this diff.

## M4 — the strict face

Confirmed derived, no edit: `StrictAnyComponentSchema` walks `AnyComponentSchema`, and the pins read it accepting every minimal and every spec-valid document of the 20, and refusing an undeclared node key by name (`unrecognized_keys`).

## The arms

- **Where the props live.** A `ComponentPropsMap` row is the spec's declaration of the props BAG — `PageComponentSchema.properties` — so each arm is `BaseSchema` + the `type` literal + `properties`, whose value IS the row, by reference through `stripImportedDefaults` (objectui#8317). Members, value types, `.describe()` text, strictness, refinements and the spec's retired-key tombstones all arrive from the spec; nothing is restated. The bag is what every one of these renderers reads (`SchemaRenderer` hoists it onto the node; the `element:*` renderers read nothing else), and what the synthesizer and page designer write.
- **Optional bag.** As on `PageComponentSchema`; the spec's props gate (`validateComponentProps`) judges a bag only when present, and so do the arms.
- **One restatement.** `element:divider`'s row is `emptyProps('element:divider')`, exported under no name, so it cannot cross the objectui#8317 boundary (its census admits only a spec binding passed straight to `stripImportedDefaults`). The arm restates it as a member-less strict object; the pin holds its key set and accept set equal to the row's.
- **One `on*` member.** `page:tabs`' renderer calls a host-injected `onTabChange` (app-shell's `withPageTabsUrlSync`), so `check:handler-key-reads` required it declared: `handlerKeyRefusal('onTabChange', 'runtime-slot', …)`. No other arm's renderer reads an `on*` key off the node (the gate: 128 arms, 50 reads, all judged).
- **Flat keys** are not judged against the block's row. A key `BaseSchema` does not declare (`{ "type": "record:details", "columns": "2" }`) passes the tolerant face, as an undeclared key does on any arm, and the strict face refuses it. A key the base does declare is judged by the base instead: `children` (`page:card`, `page:section`, `page:footer`, `page:sidebar`), `label` and `disabled` (`element:button`) and `visible` (`record:alert`) against the base's own types, and `body` (`page:card`, `record:alert`) is refused on both faces by the base's objectui#6771 retirement — a `record:alert` banner's `body` goes inside `properties`. Measured by probe on source: flat `columns` tolerant-accepted and strict-refused; flat `body` on `record:alert` and `page:card` refused on both; flat `label: 5` and `visible: 5` refused on both; the same `body` inside `record:alert`'s `properties` accepted on both.

## Census rows

`zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` `EXCLUSIONS`, 21 rows: 19 "spec-owned BY REFERENCE" (`page:tabs`' names its `onTabChange` refusal), `ElementDividerBlockSchema` "spec-owned, RESTATED" pointing at its pin, `PublicBlockComponentSchema` "a union OVER the public-block arms". No `MIRRORS` pair: no TS declaration in `@object-ui/types` restates any of these nodes. `record-components.ts`'s `Record*ComponentProps` restate six of these bags (not the nodes) on the TS face and are pinned to the spec by their own tests, not to these arms. One measured difference: `RecordRelatedListComponentProps.title` is `string` where the row takes `I18nLabel` (the row accepts `{ en: 'Tasks', 'zh-CN': '任务' }` as `title`). No `KnownDrift` or other ledger row moved.

## Pins and ablation

`public-block-arms-10872.test.ts` — per armed block: minimal document and a spec-valid bag accepted by `safeValidateSchema` and by `StrictAnyComponentSchema` (each fixture first parsed by the spec's own row); bag key set equal to the row's, and the bag IS the row object wherever the boundary strips nothing. Plus: an undeclared member inside the bag refused on the TOLERANT face by name; an undeclared node key refused on the STRICT face by name (control: tolerant passes it); a spec-refused value refused at `properties.variant`; a spec-retired key (`page:card` `actions`) refused at the member; `onTabChange` refused `custom`; a nested block judged by its own arm; `element:divider` pinned to its row both ways.

| run | result |
|---|---|
| base — detached worktree at `c6678b1bd`, the two pin files copied in | `Tests 94 failed / 6 passed (100)`. The 6 green: the four pre-existing bare-ratchet rows, the objectui#10859 README row, the namespaced non-vacuity control |
| head `4679a3120` | `100 passed` — both files, inside the full `5967 passed` run under Gates |
| ablation: `PublicBlockComponentSchema` dropped from `AnyComponentSchema`'s list | `Tests 51 failed / 49 passed (100)` |

Ablation, observed direction: red — all 40 acceptance rows, both page documents, the namespaced ratchet (`refuses 418 … the pin is 398.` + the MORE-than-the-pin guidance), the armed-list row, and every refusal row (with no arm they refuse at `type`, not by name). Green — the 43 rows that read the arms directly off `PublicBlockComponentSchema` (literal list, barrel, key sets, identity, divider) plus the 6 above; those rows are introspection, not validation. Mutation and restore through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode inside a script with its own EXIT/INT/TERM trap: anchor x1 → x0, blob `0a4466287501` → `c53fe2dc222a`, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty. Vitest aliases `@object-ui/types/zod` to `src/`, so no build sits between mutation and reading.

## The ratchet

Same file, same style, a second pin: `NAMESPACED_REFUSED_AT_TYPE = 398` (418 on `main`, less the 20), lower-it / never-raise messages, refused keys printed either way; non-vacuity (population over 400, `ui:calendar` lit, an invented key refused); a row naming the 20 armed keys. Counted apart from the bare pin because it is another card's batches. **The bare pin stays 76**: no bare literal was added. The file also runs `objectui validate` on the three-block page (exit 0, `Schema is valid`) and on the same page with an invented bag key (exit 1, the key named).

## Gates

**Fix round 2, at head `0212421eda` (text only), under the verify lock:** the tests that pin the changed texts — `check-changeset-claims.test.ts`, `changeset-polarity-census.test.ts`, `render-changeset-claims-comment.test.ts`, `markdown-test-inputs.test.ts`, `check-handler-key-read-sites.test.ts`, `public-block-arms-10872.test.ts`, `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` and the ratchet file → `Test Files 8 passed (8)`, `Tests 421 passed (421)`. No test or script quotes the rewritten prose of `public-blocks.zod.ts` (a `git grep` of that file name in tests finds the census reason keys and one header path only). exit 0: `check-changeset-presence` (`8 source file(s) of 3 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`), `pnpm changeset:check` (`No changeset declares a major bump`), `check-changeset-overwrite` (report-only: the 8344 note, frontmatter unchanged), `check:changeset-claims` (report-only; self-contradiction corpus 2 bodies, `✅ Every package declared … is either not negated`; 20 paragraphs named, the one new name — `9447-detail-view-handler-key-refusal.md`, on `check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs` — describes the gate's transitive hop and is untouched by a comment edit), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `census:changeset-polarity`, `markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit` (`105 candidate test files, all adjudicated`), `check:handler-key-reads` (`OK 128 arm(s)`), `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`).

At head `42f1cd1d2c` (fix round 1), all under the verify lock where they run tests or builds:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/ packages/cli/ scripts/__tests__/markdown-test-inputs.test.ts` plus the checker's other test readers (`detail-handler-slots-7804`, `detail-view-handler-slots-9447`, `handlerKeyDispositionsMeasured-7804`, `check-component-surface-parity`) → `Test Files 285 passed (285)`, `Tests 6049 passed (6049)` — **0 failed**.

The oracle was reading the node's top level while the designer edits `properties`. Green at the fix: the node oracle descends into a `properties` member that unwraps to an object (derived from the arm, no type list), and **0 rows stay red** — every designer field of the 20 blocks is a member of its spec row, so there is no real designer-to-row mismatch to report. No ledger or exemption row was added. Non-vacuity at the fix: `no node arms resolved` (more than 20) passes; the `object-kanban` `groupField` RETIRED / `groupBy` accepted pair passes; a new control row pins the descent both ways (`page:header` judged at its bag: `title` accepted, `icon` RETIRED, `properties` not a listed key; `object-kanban` still judged at its top level).
- **CI shard 2/8 — `check-handler-key-read-sites.test.ts`.** Red at `4679a3120` (same probe method): the objectui#9344 leg (`page:tabs` `unmirroredAlias` read `undefined`) and the objectui#9573 population (5 aliases, not 6). Green at the fix: the population is the five remaining aliases, and the `page:tabs` row asserts the new state — no `unmirroredAlias`, `schema` `PageTabsBlockSchema`, `declared` true, disposition `runtime-slot`, the arm table's own `onTabChange` member `runtime-slot`, no re-keying onto `tabs`. Ablation, WRAP mode inside a script with its own EXIT/INT/TERM trap: `type: z.literal('page:tabs'),` → `…'page:tabs-ablated-10872'…` (anchor x1 → x0, blob `33a2d8a26927` → `4f91055807d6`) → `Tests 2 failed | 47 passed (49)`: the new row (`page:tabs is an armed type, not an alias: expected { bareType: 'tabs', … } to be undefined`) and the population (6 vs 5); restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **The sweep round 0 missed.** Every test file in the repo matching `AnyComponentSchema`, `StrictAnyComponentSchema`, `safeValidateSchema`, `nodeOracles`, `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES`, `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`, `unmirroredAlias`, `collectArms`, `getPublicConfigs` or `ComponentPropsMap`, plus every test importing `@object-ui/types/zod` that walks `Object.values` / `.entries` / `.keys` or `.options`: **204 files**. The 88 under `packages/types` and `packages/cli` ran in the suite above; the other **116** ran together → `Test Files 116 passed (116)`, `Tests 2044 passed (2044)`. ## Acceptance notes

- **Held — with a declaration, not armed:**
  - `element:number` — the row requires `object`, which the spec's props gate waives when the node binds through `dataSource.object` (`DATASOURCE_SUPPLIED_PROP`, `@objectstack/lint`); the row alone would refuse that spec-valid node. Arming needs that carve-out, and `dataSource` itself is an envelope key no arm declares yet.
  - `record:line_items` — no spec row on purpose (the `STRING_ARM_REGISTERED_TYPES` ledger: to be measured from the renderer's read points). Its five registration `inputs` undercount real authoring: the showcase's project-detail page authors `title` in the bag.
  - `element:definition-list`, `element:repeater` — the spec's closed `element:` vocabulary does not declare them, so the spec refuses the type at author time while `PUBLIC_BLOCKS` curates both. Per the seat's ruling on objectui#10872 (option A), they get spec rows upstream first and stay held here until then; arming them now would make `objectui validate` accept what `os validate` refuses.
  - `action:button`, `action:group`, `action:menu`, `action:icon` — no spec row. Per the seat's ruling on objectui#10872 they stay held (option D now, route C next): no spec row yet; one is being measured from the renderers' read points upstream (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20371). The ruling's reading: `action-button.tsx` reads `schema.name ?? schema.label`, so `name` is optional where the renderer reads it, and AGENTS.md #4's taught `action:button` carries none; the spec `Action` is a different declaration (object-metadata actions keyed by `name`, recorded as structurally unrelated in `ui-action.ts`), so restating it would refuse the governed instructions file's canonical example.
- **The page pin:** the seat's ruling on objectui#10872 amends batch 1's page pin to `page:header` + `record:details` + `element:text`, which is what ships; the `action:button` page pin moves to this card's `action:*` batch.
- **No declaration anywhere:** none of the 28.
- **α batch plan (not this batch):** pair by registration, never spelling — 149 α keys reuse their bare arm under a second literal, one schema, two literals, ⛔ no copy; the 77 α′ keys follow as objectui#10859 arms each bare key. The 40 false spelling-twins (`view:grid` first among them) are β and need their own declarations.
- **Flat props channel:** whether `page:` / `record:` blocks may also author props flat on the node (their renderers read the hoisted keys) is not decided here; declaring it later is additive, and never for `element:*`, whose renderers do not read a flat key.
- **Envelope keys** the spec's `PageComponentSchema` declares beside `properties` and `BaseSchema` does not — `events`, `responsiveStyles`, `dataSource`, `aria`, `visibility` (the spec's deprecated alias of `visibleWhen`) and `responsive` (which the spec itself retired) — are not on these arms: tolerant passes them, strict refuses them. No taught public-block document carries one (the 14 teaching sites in `content`, `skills`, `docs`, `examples` and the READMEs that name an armed type, read 12 lines past each), and the strict face has no in-repo consumer, so nothing taught is newly refused.
- **Nested blocks inside a bag** (`properties.children`, `items[].children` on `page:tabs` / `page:accordion`) are `z.array(z.unknown())` in the spec rows, so a child block there is not judged by this validator — measured: an invented child type with an invented key inside `page:section`'s `properties.children` parses. That is correct by reference: the row is the spec's, and the spec does not judge it either.
- **Content channels:** objectui#9256's per-channel narrowing is not applied to the new arms (not measured for these renderers in this batch).
- **Pending changesets read.** `check:changeset-claims` named the entries that cite a file this diff touches. Falsified by this change: `8344-node-recursion-point-redirect.md` — its objectui#10859 dated note says both module counts are "one higher"; with `public-blocks.zod.ts` they are two higher. Dated note added, frontmatter byte-identical. Read and left, true of this diff: `5903`, `5928`, `6051`, `6150`, `6175`, `6639`, `7344`, `7654`, `7694`, `7804`, `8338`, `8498` and `8784` (their objectui#10859 notes describe that change's addition; no `type` literal collides), `8499` (every new arm is named on the barrel, so its figure does not move), `8572`, `8598`, `9067`, `9511`, `9659`, `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779`, `10859-ai-node-zod-arms`. `7917-export-breadcrumb-object-tree-zod-schemas.md` ("107 node component types") was already stale before this diff. A scan of pending entries naming a public-block literal beside `safeValidateSchema` / `objectui validate` / `AnyComponentSchema` found none claiming a refusal.

- **Fix round 1's census follows the change, anchor only** (ruling 5861900779 route a): the objectui#9573 alias population loses `page:tabs` because it gained an arm, not because a read was exempted, and `check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs`'s two prose paragraphs that used `page:tabs` as the alias example carry an objectui#10872 amendment.
